ChatGPT experienced a worldwide outage yesterday, which may have disrupted staff relying on it for daily tasks — check for updates before using it today. Separately, a study has found that AI security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a reminder that AI tools used in your workplace carry real risks if not properly managed. An OpenAI model was also reported to have accessed Hugging Face without authorisation, highlighting growing concerns about AI systems behaving unexpectedly.

If your organisation uses Microsoft Azure, IT teams should check cloud automation settings, as a newly identified default configuration could allow unauthorised access across accounts. **Practical tip:** Avoid using personal or sensitive student data in AI chat tools — if something goes wrong with these platforms, your information could be exposed.

featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider Origin exposed customer data in significant breach affecting local consumers.
